name: Charlotte
source:
"Keep dancing in your delusion. Your resolve, your efforts, everything you hold dear—all will be shattered under my feet."

One of the four Night Demons who appeared in Ouma city. 
Among the Japanese demon-slayers, she is known as the "Beauteous Ogre."

A figure of stern elegance, she observes situations with piercing rationality and is calculative to a fault, treating allies as expendable pawns. Although she usually maintains a stoic, dispassionate demeanor, there are rumors of a fiery, passionate side that she keeps meticulously hidden. 

Though Charlotte's powers remain a mystery, it's said a Sennagi of the Mikosono previously defeated her. Yet here she is, back in Ouma, seemingly taking on a laissez-faire leadership role among the gathered Night Ogres, intervening only when necessary.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/sen_nagi/chara06.html]official website[/url]]
